_note: Voiceover for the Diverging Route promo. 'say' is what the voice speaks (spelled for the TTS), 'caption' is what shows on screen. The first line differs by voice.

owner.say: Alright TikTok, I've got something new for you.
owner.caption: Alright TikTok…

generic.say: What happens when you bring AI into model railroading?
generic.caption: What happens when AI meets model railroading?

lines.say: It's called The Diverging Route. A new series about AI in model railroading.
lines.caption: A new series about AI in model railroading

lines.say: On a real railroad, the diverging route is the other way through a switch, where a train leaves the main line and heads somewhere new.
lines.caption: The other way through the switch

lines.say: Model railroading is a lot of hobbies in one. Historian. Carpenter. Electrician. Signal engineer. Programmer.
I've been bringing AI into every one of them. The research, the helix, the wiring, the signals, the paperwork, even speed matching locomotives.
lines.caption: AI in every part of the build

lines.say: Every job shows what I asked, what came out, and an honest verdict on how it went.
lines.caption: What I asked. What came out. The verdict.

lines.say: A different route, but the destination is the same: more time running trains.
lines.caption: Different route. Same destination.

lines.say: Find The Diverging Route at hart railroad dot com, and stay tuned for the video series.
